The '''Death of Ten Thousand Tears''' in [[Seanchan]] is a death sentence given to the members of the High [[Blood]] who displease the [[Empress]], since their blood may not be spilled. They are put bonded inside a silk sack that is suspended from a particular tower till they die and the sack rots away.
